# External hooks

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P4 · Agents everywhere](../README.md#phase-4--agents-everywhere) · **Lane:** Worker · **Label:** `feature:policy-hooks` · **Epic:** — · **Tickets:** 6 (2S 4M)

Operators can attach external checks before a request is forwarded and after a response returns: signed webhooks, OPA (REST or embedded) and CEL expressions. Hooks can only add restrictions, never allow something policy denied, and each has a timeout and fail mode.

## How we build it

- New package internal/hooks with `Hook` interface `Evaluate(ctx, Input) (Result, error)`; Result is `allow|deny` + bounded reason. Pre hooks run after policy/MCP verdict allow and before secret swap; post hooks run on response metadata before relay.
- Input is bounded metadata: identity (sub, groups, agent, grant_id), domain, port, method, path without query, MCP tool name, DLP classes, findings kinds. Tool args are passed only to in-process hooks (CEL, embedded OPA) with `includeArgs: true`; remote hooks never get bodies or args.
- Config `hooks: [{name, stage: pre|post, type: webhook|opa|cel, match: {agents, domains, tools}, timeout: 200ms, failMode: open|closed, ...}]` distributed in settings; total pre-hook budget 500ms per request.
- Webhook signs with the existing `X-Warden-Timestamp`/`X-Warden-Signature` v1 HMAC scheme from internal/integration/webhook (exported as a shared helper); response `{decision, reason}`.
- OPA: REST `POST {url}/v1/data/{path}` or embedded `github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego` with a local bundle; result `deny` bool or {deny, reason}. CEL: `github.com/google/cel-go`, compiled at load, `denyIf` expression.
- Metrics `warden_hook_duration_seconds{hook}`, `warden_hook_decisions_total{hook,decision}`, `warden_hook_errors_total{hook,kind}`; deny events use Reason `hook_<name>`.

## Done when

A CEL, OPA and webhook hook can each deny a request the policy allowed, cannot allow one it denied, and a hook timeout follows its fail mode with metrics recorded.

### 1/6 · W-P4-HOOK-01

**Add hook framework, config and pre-request stage**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Create internal/hooks with `Hook`, `Input`, `Result`, a `Chain` that runs matching hooks sequentially under per-hook timeout and total budget, and failMode handling. Add `hooks` to internal/config (strict YAML, validation) and SettingsWire; add a `hookGate` stage in internal/proxy after `mcpRequestScan`/`dlpScan` and before `swapSecrets` that writes a 403 + deny event on deny. Chain results can only deny.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A deny result blocks with Reason hook_<name>
- [ ] A hook can never turn a policy deny into allow (stage not reached)
- [ ] Timeout with failMode closed denies; open passes and counts an error

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-HOOK-02`](policy-hooks.md#26--w-p4-hook-02) Add CEL hook type; [`W-P4-HOOK-03`](policy-hooks.md#36--w-p4-hook-03) Add signed webhook hook type; [`W-P4-HOOK-04`](policy-hooks.md#46--w-p4-hook-04) Add OPA hook type, REST and embedded; [`W-P4-HOOK-05`](policy-hooks.md#56--w-p4-hook-05) Add post-response hooks

### 2/6 · W-P4-HOOK-02

**Add CEL hook type**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue —

Add `type: cel` using cel-go with declared variables `request`, `identity`, `mcp`; compile `denyIf` at config load and reject non-bool expressions. Optional `reason` string. Cost limit set on the program to bound evaluation.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Invalid expression fails config validation
- [ ] Expression on identity.groups denies matching users
- [ ] Cost limit stops a pathological expression

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-HOOK-01`](policy-hooks.md#16--w-p4-hook-01) Add hook framework, config and pre-request stage

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-HOOK-06`](policy-hooks.md#66--w-p4-hook-06) Add hook metrics and operator docs

### 3/6 · W-P4-HOOK-03

**Add signed webhook hook type**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Export the v1 HMAC signing helper from internal/integration/webhook and use it for `type: webhook` hooks: POST JSON Input with timestamp and signature headers, secret from the secret backend by reference. Parse `{decision, reason}`; non-2xx or bad JSON is an error handled by failMode. URL is never logged, only host.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Receiver can verify the signature with the documented scheme
- [ ] Non-2xx triggers failMode
- [ ] Input sent contains no args or bodies

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-HOOK-01`](policy-hooks.md#16--w-p4-hook-01) Add hook framework, config and pre-request stage

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-HOOK-06`](policy-hooks.md#66--w-p4-hook-06) Add hook metrics and operator docs

### 4/6 · W-P4-HOOK-04

**Add OPA hook type, REST and embedded**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add `type: opa` with `mode: rest` (POST `{url}/v1/data/{path}` with `{input}`) or `mode: embedded` (rego.New with a local bundle path, prepared once, reloaded on settings apply). Accept result as bool `deny` or object {deny, reason}. Embedded mode may receive args when `includeArgs: true`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] REST and embedded modes return the same decision for the same policy
- [ ] Malformed OPA result is an error under failMode
- [ ] Bundle reload happens on settings change

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-HOOK-01`](policy-hooks.md#16--w-p4-hook-01) Add hook framework, config and pre-request stage

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-HOOK-06`](policy-hooks.md#66--w-p4-hook-06) Add hook metrics and operator docs

### 5/6 · W-P4-HOOK-05

**Add post-response hooks**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Run `stage: post` hooks in internal/proxy after the upstream response is read and before relay, with Input extended by status, response DLP classes and MCP result finding kinds. For buffered responses a deny replaces the response with 403/JSON-RPC error; for streamed responses post hooks are annotate-only and record a finding.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Buffered response is blocked on deny
- [ ] Streamed response is relayed and the finding is recorded
- [ ] Post hooks never see the response body when remote

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-HOOK-01`](policy-hooks.md#16--w-p4-hook-01) Add hook framework, config and pre-request stage
